title: Zesty Irish Fish Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish dish featuring fines-herbes and tandoor spices, perfect for a chilly evening. This pescatarian-friendly stew is made with tender fish and chewy vegetables.

ingredients.name: fines-herbes
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs like parsley, chives, and dill

ingredients.name: tandoor spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cod pieces, fines-herbes, tandoor spice blend, and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using, and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
Garnish with additional chopped fines-herbes, if desired.
